title: Accountant | Bookkeeper

position_overview: WE ARE SEEKING A DETAIL-ORIENTED AND EXPERIENCED AUSTRALIAN ACCOUNTANT VA TO SUPPORT AUSTRALIAN CLIENTS WITH DAY-TO-DAY BOOKKEEPING, PAYROLL, COMPLIANCE, AND FINANCIAL REPORTING. THE IDEAL CANDIDATE HAS EXPERIENCE WORKING WITH AUSTRALIAN ACCOUNTING STANDARDS, GST, BAS, PAYROLL, AND CLOUD-BASED ACCOUNTING SOFTWARE. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Manage Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable - Perform bank, credit card, and GL reconciliations - Process payroll, STP, and superannuation - Prepare BAS, IAS, GST, and PAYG reports - Maintain accurate financial records and month-end close - Prepare financial reports (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) - Liaise with clients and external accountants - Ensure compliance with Australian accounting standards and ATO requirements REQUIRED SKILLS - Australian bookkeeping/accounting experience - Xero, MYOB, QuickBooks Online - BAS, GST, STP, Payroll, Superannuation - Bank reconciliations - Financial reporting - Microsoft Excel HAS KNOWLEDGE USING THE CRMS BELOW: - Xero, MYOB or QuickBooks Online - Dext or Hubdoc - Employment Hero or KeyPay - Karbon, Xero Practice Manager (XPM), FYI Docs - HubSpot, Salesforce or Zoho CRM (preferred) SOFT SKILLS - Strong attention to detail - Excellent communication - Time management Requirements - Reliable internet connection with backup option preferred. - Quiet and professional work-from-home setup. - Available to work full-time on a PH dayshift schedule. Why Join Us? - Competitive salary package - Permanent work-from-home opportunity - Stable dayshift schedule - Supportive and professional team environment - Opportunity to grow within a dynamic Australian property management business Apply today and become part of a growing and professional remote property management team! Benefits: - Company events - Opportunities for promotion - Pay raise - Work from home Work Location: Remote Job Type: Full-time
